description: Display file or file system status.

option.name: --cached
tip: specify how to use cached attributes; useful on remote file systems. See MODE below

option.name: --file-system
tip: display file system status instead of file status

option.name: --format
tip: use the specified FORMAT instead of the default; output a newline after each use of FORMAT

option.name: --printf
tip: like --format, but interpret backslash escapes, and do not output a mandatory trailing newline; if you want a newline, include \n in FORMAT

option.name: --terse
tip: print the information in terse form
